An upbeat month on crate labels, minutes
The lounge attendant welcomed everyone

Attendees were Caleb Larsen, Andre Cohen, and Frankie, along with the Companion Animal Travel Desk team. The group opened with a calm check-in on pet comfort, carrier readiness, and the easy handoff process at the counter. Staff agreed that the warm greeting style is helping travelers feel supported, and that clear notes between shifts keep each journey steady.

The senior coordinator shared updates on lounge flow and service touchpoints. <<FACT F047>> Team members then talked through cleanup habits, water checks, and gentle reminders for travelers to keep pets settled during boarding. <<FACT F031>> The welfare coordinator asked for continued attention to soft bedding, quiet corners, and quick follow-up when an animal seems uneasy.

The team closed by agreeing to keep the tone friendly, the process simple, and the care consistent across every trip. The meeting ended on a positive note with everyone ready for the next shift.
